messages.subject: Project Quartz — completion mechanics 28 March
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Completion is set for 28 March. Funds flow summary: total of £42,653,750, comprising net cash to sellers £33.75m, retention £2m, repayment of the Clydesford debenture £5.7m, plus fees, stamp duty (£178,750) and the W&I premium. Sources: Strathmore equity £26,553,750, Northbank senior facility £15m, and £1.1m bidco cash. Gavin — please confirm the facility will be drawn on the morning of completion.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Quartz — COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel — pleased to confirm Project Quartz has completed. The SPA is executed, the initial cash consideration of £35.75m has been paid, the £2m retention is in the joint account, and the Clydesford debenture is released. Post-completion: SH01/PSC filings and stamp duty to follow, and we'll chase the Wexbourne consent within 30 days under the specific indemnity. Congratulations.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
